title: Air conditioner control experiment (10 subjects, 4 classes, 25 EEG ch)
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 10 healthy subjects performing a P300-based brain-computer interface task for home appliance control. Participants responded to visual stimuli in a binary oddball paradigm (Target/NonTarget classification) while 25-channel EEG was recorded at 500 Hz using active electrodes in a standard 10-20 montage. The dataset includes 50 training and 30 testing trials per subject, providing a benchmark resource for P300-based BCI research and algorithm development.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using an actiCHamp system (Brain Products) with 25 active electrodes positioned according to the standard 10-20 montage and referenced to linked mastoids. Sampling rate was 500 Hz with a 60 Hz line frequency. Participants performed a visual oddball task with a stimulus onset asynchrony of 750 ms, responding to target and non-target flash stimuli presented on an LCD display. Each subject completed one session with 50 training and 30 testing blocks, with trial duration of 1.0 second.
